name: @atlitos/ui-web
description: Atlitos shared web UI primitives, consumed by apps/portal-court, apps/portal-life, and apps/admin. Ships Eyebrow (uppercase mono section label) and BillSummary (the one shared money-summary component, CLAUDE.md's financial invariant) today; later phases grow this into the full shared web primitive set that sits alongside each portal's own shadcn/ui component bones.

scripts.dev: echo "@atlitos/ui-web has no standalone dev server, it is consumed by the portal apps"
